en: The Almighty God with his power
There is nothing He can not do

ko: 우리의 모든 간구도 우리의 모든 생각도
en: All the prayers, and thoughts form us
All the dreams and hopes in our hearts

ko: 우리의 모든 괴로움 바꿀 수 있네
en: Make my painful toils fade away
God does act impossible, but he is possible And raises the dead our of the ground There is no one who beat him

ko: 주의 말씀 의지하여 깊은 곳에 그물 던져
오늘 그가 놀라운 일을 이루시는 것 보라
en: Trust the word of the Lord so Let down the net into the deep water Now behold the great wonder He has done

ko: 주의 말씀 의지하여 믿음으로 그물 던져
en: The word of the Lord your trust in with faith throw the net For believers nothing is impossible
